ModMetaData.description:
[h1]RimMind - Extension: ModelService (v2.0)[/h1] Enterprise multi-provider gateway, Anthropic Claude native protocol adapter, local subscription loopback guard, and zero-downtime failover load balancer for the RimMind suite. Extends [code]RimMind-Core[/code] with multi-node routing, hardware-level ephemeral KV caching, and real-time endpoint health diagnostics.
[b]v2.0 Clean Architecture & RimWorld 1.6 / 1.7 Dual-Version Support:[/b] [list] [*][b]RimWorld 1.6 & 1.7 (Waylith / .NET 10) Ready[/b]: Native multi-target compilation supporting both RimWorld 1.6 (.NET Framework 4.8) and RimWorld 1.7 (.NET 10 / Harmony 2.x & 3.x). [*][b]Multi-Provider Protocol Adapters[/b]: Seamlessly routes across OpenAI-compatible APIs, native [b]Anthropic Claude Messages API[/b] (with [code]cache_control: ephemeral[/code]), [b]OpenCode Go[/b] subscription presets, and local subscription gateways ([b]Codex Proxy, Sub2API, NewAPI[/b]). [*][b]Failover Load Balancing & Circuit Breaker[/b]: Supports [code]PriorityFailover[/code] and [code]RoundRobin[/code] routing across multiple endpoint nodes with 60-second automatic circuit isolation. [/list]
[h2]What Is RimMind[/h2] RimMind is an enterprise-grade, AI-powered RimWorld mod suite. Integrated with Large Language Models (LLM), it transforms colonists into self-reflecting agents with distinct personalities, three-tier memories, natural spoken dialogues, autonomous mechanisms, and dynamic storytelling.

[h2]Core Features[/h2] [list] [*][b]Multi-Provider Protocol Routing[/b] - Plugs directly into [code]RimMind-Core[/code]'s [code]IAIClientFactory[/code] registry to support [code]OpenAICompatible[/code], [code]AnthropicClaude[/code], [code]LocalSubscriptionGateway[/code], and [code]OpenCodeGo[/code] endpoints. [*][b]Anthropic Ephemeral KV-Cache Adapter[/b] - Native Anthropic [code]/v1/messages[/code] protocol support that automatically tags static Zone 1 & Zone 2 prefix blocks with [code]cache_control: ephemeral[/code], slashing Claude latency and token costs. [*][b]OpenCode Go & Local Gateway Presets[/b] - One-click setup for OpenCode Go ([code]https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1[/code] with [code]x-opencode-session[/code] isolation) and local proxy gateways (Codex, Sub2API, NewAPI). [*][b]Local Loopback Security Guard ([code]LocalLoopbackValidator[/code])[/b] - Strictly verifies loopback addresses ([code]127.0.0.1[/code], [code]localhost[/code], [code]::1[/code]) for local subscription proxies to prevent accidental token leakage over public networks. [*][b]Priority Failover & Round-Robin Load Balancing[/b] - Automatically shifts traffic away from rate-limited (HTTP 429) or unhealthy (5xx/timeout) nodes for 60 seconds, with one-click millisecond RTT health probing ([code]EndpointHealthProbe[/code]) and F8 Debug Hub telemetry. [/list]
[h2]Supported Gateway Modes[/h2] [table] [tr][th]Provider Mode[/th][th]Protocol & Features[/th][th]Best Use Case[/th][/tr] [tr][td]OpenAICompatible[/td][td]Standard /v1/chat/completions with ToolCalls[/td][td]DeepSeek, OpenAI, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, Ollama, vLLM[/td][/tr] [tr][td]AnthropicClaude[/td][td]Native /v1/messages + ephemeral prefix caching[/td][td]Claude 3.5 Sonnet / Haiku with hardware KV cache reuse[/td][/tr] [tr][td]LocalSubscriptionGateway[/td][td]Loopback-guarded local proxy (127.0.0.1 / ::1)[/td][td]Codex Proxy, Sub2API, NewAPI, CLIProxyAPI local gateways[/td][/tr] [tr][td]OpenCodeGo[/td][td]Session-isolated OpenCode Go cloud preset[/td][td]One-click OpenCode Go subscription routing[/td][/tr] [/table]
[h2]Frequently Asked Questions[/h2] [b]Q: How do I enable multi-node load balancing?[/b] A: Open [b]Options / Mod Settings / RimMind - Extended Model Service[/b], enable Extended Service, choose [i]PriorityFailover[/i] or [i]RoundRobin[/i], and add your endpoint nodes.
[b]Q: What happens if my primary endpoint hits a 429 rate limit?[/b] A: The load balancer immediately isolates the degraded node for 60 seconds and transparently retries the request on your next healthy backup node without dropping the colonist's action.
